name: Spark Savings USDT
oneLiner: spUSDT is Spark's yield-bearing USDT wrapper for Spark Liquidity Layer allocations, accruing protocol-set returns from SLL deployment routes.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: spUSDT resolves to Upstream because the wrapper holds USDT as its only reserve, inheriting Tether's blacklist surface.

collateral: USDT deposited into Spark Savings Vault V2 (ERC-4626 asset=USDT); idle USDT is taken by the Spark Liquidity Layer into SparkLend, Morpho, and other supported yield strategies, with Spark docs framing V2 USD vaults as economically backed by USDS / Sky balance-sheet liquidity for redemptions.
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDT into Spark Savings Vault V2 and receive spUSDT; a permissioned Spark Liquidity Layer taker deploys idle USDT into yield strategies while share value accrues via the vault savings rate (vsr), not the Sky Savings Rate or legacy sUSDC path.

mintAuthority.summary: spUSDT is a Spark ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDT. Wrapper shares are minted against deposited USDT and inherit Tether USDT's reviewed issuer/multisig mint authority for base supply. The wrapper is UUPS-upgradeable by the Spark SubProxy through Sky governance's enforceable 48-hour DSPause path.

controls.label: Spark Savings USDT vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 share accounting over deposited USDT; does not mint base USDT.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, the vault was an ERC1967 UUPS proxy with implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455 and zero admin and beacon slots. asset() returned USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE had one member, SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4.

controls.label: Spark/Sky SubProxy upgrade governance (48-hour DSPause)
controls.capDescription: The SubProxy is the vault's sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member. Sky governance can replace the UUPS implementation or raise the deposit cap through the 48-hour DSPause path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, the SparkVault implementation authorized UUPS upgrades only for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, whose sole member was SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. Its arbitrary-execution path resolved through DSPauseProxy 0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB, owned by DSPause 0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3 with delay()=172800 and authority Sky Chief 0x929d9A1435662357F54AdcF64DcEE4d6b867a6f9. StarGuard's 604800 maxDelay is an execution-expiry window rather than a mandatory delay.

controls.label: Inherited Ethereum USDT token owner multisig

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, spUSDT vault 0xe2e7a17dff93280dec073c995595155283e3c372 was a UUPS proxy using SparkVault implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455. Its sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member was Spark SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. Arbitrary SubProxy execution flowed through DSPauseProxy and DSPause with a mandatory 172800-second delay under live Sky Chief governance. StarGuard's seven-day maxDelay was only an expiry bound. Wrapper shares remained collateralized by deposited USDT and did not create base USDT supply.
